spec_match.rationale: Real AES-GCM via crypto.subtle plus real toBase64()/fromBase64() at the transport boundary — the practical use case the proposal cites.

interactive.rationale: Encrypt → auto-fill → decrypt verified live; tampering with the ciphertext produces the failure branch.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb matches the encrypt→encode→decode→decrypt cycle exactly.

edge_cases.rationale: Tamper/wrong-key failure works, but AES-GCM OperationError has an empty message so the status reads 'Decryption failed:  (Did you…' — cosmetic but sloppy; new-key-per-reload caveat only surfaces through that same error.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless via CDP/puppeteer 2026-08-30 (feature natively supported — shipped Chrome 140): every button/sample/control driven, DOM readouts verified after each action, console clean (only sandbox-blocked external font fetch), zero page overflow at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3, full-page screenshots read. Full cycle verified including tamper path; guard added 2026-08-30 disables buttons with an honest message when the codec is absent instead of blaming 'Encryption failed'.

design_system.rationale: Status colours use registered --demo-color variables; after review the ok-state text is charcoal on the pale green (13.1:1) — the earlier emerald-on-pale-green estimate (~4.6:1) was optimistic, actual ~3.9:1.

accessibility.rationale: Textareas labelled; the status line — the page's main feedback channel — is not aria-live.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Panels stack at 540px; zero overflow both classes.

openQuestions.title: Name the failure when OperationError has no message
openQuestions.detail: Map an empty e.message to 'authentication failed (wrong key or tampered data)' so the error line doesn't render a dangling colon.

openQuestions.title: Make #status aria-live
openQuestions.detail: All encrypt/decrypt outcomes flow through the status line; polite live-region semantics would announce them.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive demo layout without horizontal overflow mobile touch targets
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Design tokens, adequate touch targets, visible focus, honest capability handling.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Pages already use CSS variables throughout; verified zero page overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 for all six concepts; fixes kept the existing token-based styling.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP probe: documentElement.scrollWidth - clientWidth == 0 on all 6 concepts, both classes

guidanceConsulted.query: status message live region labelled form controls
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label controls; surface state changes as text; keep native elements for keyboard support.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Existing labels/aria-labels verified; remaining gaps (status bars not aria-live, hex cells click-only) recorded as open questions rather than silently passed.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: page source review + CDP interaction transcript 2026-08-30

summary: Full encrypt→encode→decode→decrypt cycle plus tamper branch verified on the real APIs. Guard added 2026-08-30: missing codec is now reported honestly at load instead of surfacing as a misleading 'Encryption failed: iv.toBase64 is not a function'. [review follow-up 2026-08-30 #2] Codex contrast findings fixed: supported badges now --text-black on emerald (5.10:1), success/match readouts use black-on-emerald chips or charcoal text (12+:1), padding warning charcoal (12.4:1), webcrypto status-ok charcoal (13.1:1); all measured live via computed styles.
